whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Dental Sutraa,

I noticed your clinic has a stellar 5.0★ rating in Kankarbagh, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for direct patient appointments.

Maine aapke dental clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp appointment booking, treatment menu, aur clinic location integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/dentalsutraa

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Dental Sutraa team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with 5.0-star patient reviews and direct WhatsApp booking for Kankarbagh patients. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual clinic photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
